_about: Docura design tokens v1. Made from scratch: no Khosmos screenshots, colours, fonts or layouts were used. Direction: 'site notebook'. A warm paper ground, ink text, a signal-saffron action colour that stays readable in sunlight, document-like ruled lists, tabular figures. Role names are fixed and replica-brand may change values. Check every change with: python contrast.py tokens.json

_color_notes.greys: 7 neutrals: bg, surface, surface-sunken, border, border-input, text-muted, text
_color_notes.border: decorative dividers only. Anything a user must find (inputs, checkboxes, the signature pad) uses border-input (3:1 or better)
_color_notes.accent: fill only, and always with an ink label (buttons, FAB). Saffron is 1.8:1 on white, so it never carries state by itself: switches, checkboxes, progress bars and selected indicators use control-on (ink). Never use accent as text on a light ground: use accent-text
_color_notes.sunlight: body text is 16:1 or better, muted text 5.5:1 or better on every ground, above the AA floor on purpose

font.mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace
font._loading: Load these Google Fonts subsets: cyrillic, cyrillic-ext (Kazakh letters), latin, latin-ext (₸ U+20B8 is here). Never ship only latin + cyrillic. Onest weights 400, 500, 600, 700, 800 (variable 100-900). IBM Plex Mono 400 and 500, for identifiers only: document numbers, ИИН/БИН, ИИК
font._features: Numbers that line up use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (Onest has tnum)
font._checked: Coverage checked on the font files: Onest and IBM Plex Mono contain А-я Ёё, ӘәҒғҚқҢңӨөҰұҮүҺһІі, ₸, №, U+00A0, U+2212, «». Onest also has U+202F and tnum

type._rules: Inputs are never below 16px (stops iOS zoom). No ALL-CAPS labels: uppercase Cyrillic gets very wide. Letter-spacing 0 everywhere except caption (+0.01em)

_print.title: 14pt/18pt bold
_print._note: A4 documents (КП, счёт, АВР) are set in pt, not px

shadow._rule: Cards are flat: a 1px border, no shadow. Shadows only on things that float (bottom bar, sheets, menus, toasts)

motion._reduced: prefers-reduced-motion: no slide, only a 120ms opacity change

size._rule: Nothing tappable is under 48x48 on mobile, including the hit area of icon buttons and checkboxes. Primary actions are 56px tall in the bottom action bar

layout._rule: Mobile-first. Below lg: bottom tab bar, sticky bottom action bar inside the thumb zone, one column. lg and up: left sidebar, two columns in editors (form + live A4 preview)
